title: Matching headings by paragraph function
source: Language Learning Hub · original V4.4 teaching draft, not an external textbook
goal: Apply matching headings by paragraph function in an original academic-English context and explain reasoning in coherent English
context: 为学术段落选标题，关注段落功能而非重复出现的词。
grammar: topic 与 function 不同：一段谈种子可以是在解释方法、质疑结果或提出替代方案。however/often overlooked 等线索帮助识别功能，标题应覆盖整段而非一条例子。
common_mistake: 标题含原文关键词并不代表它准确概括主要作用。

reading: Seed banks are often described as secure archives of future crops. Yet storing seeds is not equivalent to preserving a crop indefinitely. Some species tolerate drying poorly, and even suitable seeds require periodic testing. Staff must sometimes grow new plants to replenish a collection, which creates further demands for land and labour. These practical limits do not make seed banks useless. They show why conservation strategies also include living collections and cooperation with growers. The paragraph therefore examines the limits of a single method rather than narrating the history of agriculture.
